params.name: zalando_advice_ids
params.description: Zalando advice ids to filter inbounded items by. Returns items for all advice ids if not provided.

params.name: from
params.description: Start timestamp. Default is now minus 100 days.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of inbounded items to fetch per page. Maximum is 200000.

items.docs: Returns all items inbounded at Zalando warehouses for specific `merchant-id` and `zalando_advice_ids`. Endpoint has no 100 days time limitation, but to not overload the client, it provides cursor based pagination. The cursor is a string that is returned in the response and can be used to fetch the next page of results. Please note that if `from` and `to` parameters are not provided the API will return the data for the last 100 days.
